5 · Ranked defects & suggested fixes (not applied)

1 · Crossover ramp is 10–11 % grade, with 12.6 m under-clearance. Measured +10.9 % (0.840) / −9.9 % (0.865); lower y≈7.7 vs upper y≈20.1. js/circuits/suzuka.js:53 bridges rise:10 halfM:160 stacks on the SRTM climb (y 11.7 → 20.1 over 0.80–0.845). Fix: lower rise and/or widen halfM so the grade is ≤ ~6 %, then re-derive xoverClear (scenery :604-607). Real overpass clearance is not verified (guess ≈5–6 m).
2 · Pyramid hills. The near mountain ring uses seg:8, one flat colour, wide base: reads as a pointy light-green pyramid beside the stands (eye 0.50 / 0.83, orbit 0.50). scenery/suzuka.js:41-56 (first ring: extra 160, wMin 280, hMin 44). Fix: raise seg, vary the profile or push the ring out.
3 · Storm / wet reflections of props are blocky and noisy (orbit day-storm 0.17/0.33, day-wet). Engine screen-space reflection, not circuit data: js/lighting/atmosphere.js / weather blend path (PR #1979 area) (guess: reflection resolution).
4 · Night lamp pools are stair-stepped. Light pools around posts show quantised edges (night-dry 0.17, 0.50). Mechanism guess: low-resolution spot/lamp light grid; not circuit-specific.
5 · Degner/hairpin "track signs" are solid 3 m cuboids. scenery/suzuka.js:573-580 trackSigns size [3,3,30], count 8 / [3,3,26], count 7 via circuit-kit.js:374; they read as red/grey/blue blocks, not boards (orbit day-dry 0.33). Fix: thin the depth axis or use a billboard emitter.
6 · Hairpin footbridge crowds the apex. scenery/suzuka.js:422 footbridge(…, 0.500, 7.5) spans the R19 apex (curvature peak 0.499), a flex stand (:806) is 8 m off the road beside the leg, and the bridge is the same green as the crossover spans. Fix: move to a straight (e.g. 0.455 or 0.52) or drop; verify with float-audit.
7 · Crossover green span ignores weather darkening. In day-storm 0.67 (and rain) a bright green slab shows above the skyline. Likely emissive-like flat colour XOVER_GREEN (:601) with no weather response (unconfirmed which mesh).
8 · Leafless "momiji" trees. A bare brown tree stands at the Esses (eye 0.17). scenery/suzuka.js:499-509 broadleafFall lobes:4; some lobes miss the foliage (guess).
9 · Two gantries at the line (teal start gantry :337 plus a dark red-pillared span) — the second belongs to the engine pit complex (guess, not traced); reads as duplicated.
10 · Capture-state inconsistency. day-fog 0.17 shows an AI field on the road; no other group does. Tooling: tools/shot/shot.mjs scene state differs per group.
11 · Gallery parser gap. WEATHER_TAIL in tools/track/build-gallery.cjs:41 lacks storm: day-storm frames parse as weather "storm", tod "unknown". Add storm to the regex.
12 · 130R / 200R built radii are tighter than nominal at single nodes (81 m vs 130 m; 122 m vs 200 m) (possibly curvature-noise; window means 269 / 189). Needs a rendered lap before any curvature edit (AGENTS.md).
